name: China Academy of Space Technology 513 Research Institute
aliases: Shandong Institute of Space Electronic Technology
supervisors: China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation (CASC)

evidence.summary: The US Entity List names it as “China Academy of Space Technology 513 Research Institute”, a research institute of the China Academy of Space Technology (CAST), which CASC lists among its eight research academies. CASC is one of the state-owned defence-industry groups that SASTIND lists, and says it researches, designs, builds and tests strategic and tactical missiles as well as launch vehicles and spacecraft. The US Commerce Department listed it in August 2022 for acquiring and attempting to acquire US-origin items in support of China’s military modernization.
It belongs to CASC, which describes itself as a very large state-owned enterprise and a cornerstone of China’s national security strategy.
